scope: Read-only activation and outcome review of recent recall, JEV, skills and optional graph implementation; no provider calls or jobs were initiated

source_and_install.evidence: Existing 2026-09-27 deployment summary records 438 identical packaged files in general and scheduled runtimes and fresh hook delivery; this review did not rehash installed files. Ledger activity through 2026-09-28T13:06Z independently confirms current JEV use.

effective_activation.interpretation: JEV global mode resolves to live for all eight surfaces, but a surface without eligible work or integration calls produces no ledger row. Graph expansion resolves to off by default. The installed hook declaration and fresh prior delivery support installed recall; existing long-lived process environments were not enumerated. No credential value was read or reported.

cost_and_receipt_limits: Ledger cost is a token-rate calculation, not a provider invoice or cash-billing proof. On successful responses, transport uses provider token usage when reported and otherwise estimates input tokens; this estimated-versus-reported flag is not stored in the decision table. Timeout and other possibly billed errors retain estimated input-token cost and may lack model_served. Structural completeness means question_set_id, policy_version, action_taken and transport_outcome are populated; orphan send intents have no decision receipt and count toward spend/request caps. Attempts count sends, not unique user prompts.

authoritative_data.skill_acceptance: UNMEASURED: JEV S5 is configured live but has zero skill decisions and no approved skill claims to choose or deliver. Installed filesystem skills are a separate catalog.
authoritative_data.graph_acceptance: UNMEASURED: raw active-endpoint counts do not establish authorization, currentness, citation validity or useful graph expansion. The feature remains disabled and the completed historical queue does not prove active quality.

outcomes.interpretation: These are recorded machine or lifecycle events, not independently labeled relevance, solved-task outcomes, causal JEV gains, or human judgments. The 24h and 72h windows have no S5/S7 decisions; retention and sparse joins prevent an outcome acceptance claim.

feature_verdicts.recall_complete_text_delivery: PASS for prior installed fresh-session canary and bounded fixture; live semantic usefulness UNMEASURED, and strict 1500 ms stress deadline remains FAIL in the dated report
feature_verdicts.jev_recall: ACTIVE_WITH_LIMITS: current live decisions and low 24h fallback rate; semantic benefit, privacy egress audit and task success UNMEASURED
feature_verdicts.jev_hints_ingest_revalidate_session: ACTIVE_WITH_LIMITS: current live rows and receipts, but no independent usefulness/accuracy labels
feature_verdicts.jev_skills: INACTIVE_IN_PRACTICE: configured live with zero authorized skill claims and zero S5 rows
feature_verdicts.jev_route: UNOBSERVED: configured live globally, zero S7 rows; route integration only runs at auto-classification sites
feature_verdicts.jev_dedup: SPARSE: one live S4 row in 72h and none in 24h; no quality conclusion
feature_verdicts.graph_expansion: OFF: optional mode unset; no current supported entity edges and no measured relational improvement

acceptance_gaps: Fresh independently labeled semantic recall and skills tasks with current lifecycle eligibility
Delivered citation/support correctness and measured solved-task outcomes
Provider invoice reconciliation or durable recorded token provenance for estimated versus reported usage
Timeout/orphan reduction and strict hook deadline acceptance
S5 catalog and S7 route exposure sufficient to measure their effect
Authorized confirmed-support graph cohort before considering opt-in activation
method: Both SQLite databases opened by URI mode=ro with PRAGMA query_only=ON. Queries used aggregate counts only; no claim text, request state, credentials or private paths were copied. Settings inspection was restricted to named activation keys.
